notes.title: Update 2.0 Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello,

Thanks for your patience waiting for this next update. I'd like to give you a quick overview of what's coming up soon...

[h2]Where are versions 1.17, 1.18 and 1.19?[/h2]
Thrown under the bus. Forget about them. They don't exist.
Joking aside, the current goals of the project were initially being split up into smaller updates, these updates would have taken us from 1.16 up to 1.19, however I thought it would be best to combine everything into a larger 2.0 update.

[h2]What's coming?[/h2]
[strike]Really long paragraph explaining all the changes in version 2.0[/strike]
Bullet points!
[list]
[*] Weather! (sun, rain, snow)
[*] Improved ambience (audio/visual)
[*] Reworked UI (again)
[*] New buildings!
[*] Name your islands
[*] Bug fixes and QoL improvements
[/list]
[h2]Sneaky Peak![/h2]
Sneaky screenshot time! In this image you will see the new UI, the island list, new tooltips and rain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257404/b59d89e087d7a1e347245c80aa0a0890fa659b06.png[/img]

That's all for now until the update drops, I still have quite a lot of work to do so I can't give a specific date. Don't forget to check out my [url=http://discord.gg/2uTq5GXCfy]Discord[/url] for more frequent updates and if you have questions, it's a great place to ask!

Thanks,
Matt.

notes.title: Quick Update and Feedback
notes.notes:
Hi all! 

I'd like to take the opportunity to give a little update on what's coming to Poly Skies in the immediate future, although, this update may be a little delayed due to some personal reasons.

[h3]Update 1.16[/h3]
Here's a few changes coming to update 1.16...
- UI rework, a new, clean and transparent UI will replace the old version.
- Amongst other fixes, I have address various crashes.
- Multiple VFX changes and additions.
- Improved lighting and colours.
- UI performance improvements.
- And more...

[h3]UI Changes:[/h3]
I'd like to ask for some feedback regarding the UI changes due in update 1.16. Below, I have a comparison screenshot of the old and new, which do you prefer?
In-game UI:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257404/e85e93ad8d781d553933dce962d14ae3e62a9ed9.png[/img]

- Buildings will now appear to be on fire if damaged

[b]GENERAL CHANGES:[/b]
- Portals can now only be moved onto the same island they were built on (fixes Island unlock exploit)

- 'Food Shortage' quest now correctly says 'Plot' instead of 'Farm'
- Trading Strawberries now displays the correct value
- Added which tier each buildings belongs to in tooltips
- Save/Load game list now scrolls correctly
- List of save games is now sorted by most recent
- Overwriting a save file now requires confirmation

notes.title: Major Update v1.11 (Mar 3, 2023)
notes.notes:
Hi all, this major update contains farming plots, food resource separation, fixes for a few serious bugs and hopefully a small performance boost. Thank you for all that have played the game and especially to those who provided feedback via the Discussion boards or Discord. Changes below...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257404/9feeb75a51383c0d111a77061a3015d43dd3ba3e.png[/img]

[b]ADDED:[/b]
- The food resource has been split and new resources added:
*Wheat
*Corn
*Fish
*Strawberries
- New building "Plot" for growing crops (Tier 1)
- Wheat Mill and Watch Balloon now show radius of effect
- Villagers will now eat random food items (no priority)
- Villagers will now sometimes display their current thoughts
- Achievements "Strawberry Delight", "Golden Harvest", "Kernel King", "Master Angler"
- New large island variety

[b]CHANGED:[/b]
- "Farm" renamed to "Wheat Mill", taking 1 villager, and is now Tier 2
- Wheat Mill now boosts up to 8 nearby plots by 2x
- Slightly reduced output of the Wheat Mill to balance new food resources
- Made the collision boxes of some buildings smaller
- Square path is now Tier 1
- Background mountain models

[b]FIXED:[/b]
- Arborist no longer breaks if you manually chop down a tree (for real this time!)
- Arborist no longer moves existing trees when moving the building (also for real this time!)
- Mass building feature no longer used when moving buildings, causing incorrect building to be selected
- Various issues with Snatchers, including a case of a memory leak 

[b]PERFORMANCE:[/b]
- Added LODs to islands, decreasing load on the CPU

If you experience any bugs please report them on the discussions board or my [url=http://discord.gg/2uTq5GXCfy]Discord[/url]. The demo version of the game has also been updated with all recent changes.

Thanks,
Matt, Red Phoenix Studios.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Poly Skies is OUT NOW! [/h1]

[h2]Why now?[/h2]
The Steam Base Builder Fest is now underway and I thought this would be a great time to release alongside it. I have also created a bundle that included the prequel, Poly Towns, for a 15% discount when buying as a bundle.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
Content and bug fixes, these are both my top priority right now. I didn't have time to implement every feature I have on my TODO list. I will create a pinned discussion to show and keep track of what content is upcoming.

As always, please leave feedback in the discussion area or on my Discord. I am always happy to listen and help. I am a one man development team, it gives me great joy to make games and hear what you think!

Matt.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Firstly, thank you so much for all the feedback so far! This has been a massive help in making sure I get things right. I started this project in November 2021 all by myself as a solo-developer; Considering I have a full-time job and study at University, it has come a long way.

[h3]The bad:[/h3]
I will likely have to push back the release of Poly Skies to the very end of summer, looking at a late August/Early September release.

[h3]The good:[/h3]
Development has not stopped and I will be starting a new job next month that will allow me to put in more time to work on Poly Skies. I still have a lot planned, below is a quick run-down of some of them (backlog is planned for release but I do not currently have specific time-frames for them):

[list]
[*] Main buildings - 11 / 16 completed so far
[*] Decor items - [i]Starting this month[/i]
[*] Villager details - Backstory, current mood/thoughts - [i]Starting this month[/i]
[*] Building system improvements - Snapping, multi-placement - [i]Starting this month[/i]
[*] Stranded villagers - Build a Portal connection to their island to save them - [i]Backlog[/i]
[*] Creative mode - Build without resources or building tier limitations - [i]Backlog[/i]
[*] Island generation improvements - Flora, map size - [i]Backlog[/i]
[*] Visual improvements - Improved atmosphere/ambience, post-processing tweaks - [i]Backlog[/i]
[*] Steam Achievements - [i]Backlog[/i]
[*] Localization - [i]Ongoing[/i]
[/list]
As always, if you have feedback from the demo version, please head to the discussions or my [url=discord.gg/2uTq5GXCfy]Discord[/url].

Have a good weekend! ːsteamhappyː
- Matt.
